sn12.12:1.2: Cattāro me bhikkhave āhārā bhūtānaṃ vā sattānam ṭhitiyā sambhavesīnam vā anuggahāya || ||
sn12.12:1.4: Kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro oḷāriko vā sukhumo vā || phasso dutiyo || manosañcetanā tatiyo || viññānaṃ catutthaṃ ||
sn12.12:1.5: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro āhārā bhūtānaṃ vā sattānaṃ ṭhitiyā sambhavesīnaṃ vā anuggahāyāti || 3
sn12.12:2.1: Evam vutte āyasmā Moliya-Phagguno Bhagavantam etad avoca ||
sn12.12:2.2: Ko nu kho bhante viññāṇāhāram āhāretīti || ||
sn12.12:2.5: āhāretīti cāhaṃ vadeyyaṃ tatrassa kallo pañho
sn12.12:2.8: evaṃ mam avadantaṃ yo evam puccheyya
sn12.12:2.9: Kissa nu kho bhante viññāṇāhāro ti || esa kallo pañho ||
sn12.12:2.11: Viññāñāhāro āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbattiyā paccayo || tasmiṃ bhūte sati saḷāyatanaṃ saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso ti || || 4
sn12.12:3.4: phusatīti cāham vadeyyam tatrassa kallo pañho
sn12.12:3.7: evam mam avadantaṃ yo evam puccheyya
sn12.12:3.8: Kimpaccayā nu kho bhante phassoti || esa kallo pañho ||
sn12.12:4.4: vediyatīti cāhaṃ vadeyyam tatrassa kallo pañho
sn12.12:4.7: evam mam avadantaṃ yo evam puccheyya ||
sn12.12:4.8: kim paccayā nu kho bhante vedanati || esa kallo paṇho ||
sn12.12:5.2: No kallo pañho ti Bhagavā avoca ||
sn12.12:5.4: tasatīti cāham vadeyyam tatrassa kallo pañho
sn12.12:5.7: evam mam avadantaṃ yo evam puccheyya
sn12.12:5.8: Kim paccayā nu kho bhante taṇhāti || esa kallo pañho ||
sn12.12:6.4: upādiyatīti cāhaṃ vadeyyam tatrassa kallo pañho
sn12.12:6.7: evam mam avadantaṃ yo evam puccheyya
sn12.12:6.8: Kim paccayā nu kho bhante upādānanti || esa kallo pañho ||
sn12.12:6.12: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || 8
sn12.12:7.1: Channam tveva Phagguna phassāyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā phassanirodho ||
sn12.12:7.8: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || ||
